description:
Found 2026-09-14 while grokking selective receive for 8b. runtime/src/park.rs:21-23 states the matcher allocates nothing and cites check_pure_codegen, which does not exist anywhere in the tree. Violations: fz_bs_reader_init_ref allocates a 3-tuple and fz_bs_read_field_ref a result tuple per field on process->heap (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:1286-1300, 1336-1420), both called from the matcher (native_codegen/receive.rs:1093-1110); the interpreter's guard evaluation can allocate a UTF-8 binary on the SENDER's heap at probe time (src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:451-467); a bound binary field becomes a view on the receiver's heap that points into the sender's heap. Heap asymmetry: JIT (src/exec/runtime.rs:203) and interp (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:282) run the receiver's matcher against a message still in the sender's heap while passing the receiver's *mut Process; AOT deep-copies into the receiver first (aot_shim.rs:535-542). Nothing records whose heap a matcher may touch. Also: receive.rs module doc (lines 4-17) omits the process parameter of MatcherFn.

The contract, stated: the matcher allocates nothing that outlives the decision. It may read through the process (atom table, schemas). Views and other static-shape intermediates ride in lanes; bound values are written to out as words and materialized by the receiver at clause entry, after delivery.

Resolution, in this order: the bitstring reader in lanes (fz-21x.22) removes the tuples and the cross-heap view; the effects fact (fz-21x.23) is the contract as a fact; guards as code (fz-21x.24) makes the guard function a body the fact covers. This ticket is then the enforcement and the doc: every function the matcher body calls has allocates = false, checked where the matcher is emitted, as a compile error; receive.rs and park.rs state the process parameter and the per-door heap rule. Proof: a test that a matcher calling an allocating helper is refused at emit time; heap counters around a receive with a binary pattern and a guard show zero allocation on the probing side on three doors.
title: Matcher purity contract is asserted, unenforced, and violated; whose heap at probe time is per-door
